title: 34.1 A 65fsrms-Jitter and -272dB-FoMjitter, N 10.1GHz Fractional-N Digital PLL with a Quantization-Error-Compensating BBPD and an Orthogonal-Polynomial LMS Calibration
problem: Fractional-N digital PLLs suffer from quantization errors in ΔΣ modulators that dominate in-band phase noise; digital-to-time converters (DTCs) mitigate ΔΣ Q-error but introduce thermal noise proportional to delay, creating a power-jitter tradeoff that degrades overall FoM.
motivation: Ultra-low jitter frequency synthesizers are critical for high-data-rate wireline and wireless communications; achieving sub-100 fs jitter in nanometer CMOS requires novel quantization-error cancellation that doesn't compromise power efficiency.
method: The design uses a bang-bang phase detector (a device that measures whether the clock is too fast or too slow) to directly correct quantization errors—the rounding mistakes made by the delta-sigma modulator that divides the frequency. Normally, a digital-to-time converter would fix these errors, but it consumes a lot of power and adds thermal noise that degrades clock quality; this approach avoids that tradeoff. The chip uses orthogonal-polynomial LMS calibration—an adaptive algorithm—to keep the correction working across manufacturing variations, voltage changes, and temperature swings.
key_novelty: A bang-bang phase detector directly corrects delta-sigma quantization errors without needing a power-hungry converter (which would create thermal noise), and orthogonal-polynomial LMS calibration automatically adapts this correction across manufacturing, voltage, and temperature variations.
contributions: Quantization-error-compensating BBPD architecture that eliminates need for high-power DTC
Orthogonal-polynomial LMS calibration enabling stable adaptation across PVT corners
Sub-100 fs RMS jitter (65 fs) at 10.1 GHz with -272 dB FoMjitter
Fractional-N operation with low in-band phase noise from ΔΣ error elimination
limitations: Absolute power consumption and area not specified in abstract; loop-bandwidth and settling-time details absent.
primary_theme: Ultra-low-jitter fractional-N DPLL with quantization-error-compensating BBPD
